criteria.statement: Continuity definitions are stored in memory by service key and only newer replaceable events replace existing profiles, replication policies, or recipes.
Stored definitions are returned as defensive copies and listed deterministically.
The trigger engine enumerates profiles, evaluates heartbeat_loss recipes, and transitions expired primary heartbeats through suspect before firing.
The trigger engine emits exactly one FailoverRequested event per active service run and does not auto-recover when the primary heartbeat returns.
If no eligible non-primary standby replication target exists, the engine emits a failed status event once and suppresses duplicate threshold crossings.
Services without a heartbeat snapshot remain unarmed and healthy heartbeats clear suspect state before any run fires.
An external status projector can mark a matching firing run active without accepting unrelated run IDs.
